comparison.objective: Hold a notice at a marked line and pin it to a tilted cork board; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually position a sliding card and drive a small pin with sufficient insertion force versus seat a hex bit, tune a collar, reacquire the socket, and relock it.
comparison.success_condition: Notice hangs straight at the line from a seated pin after release versus two consecutive compliant stops with bounded forces and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Small-part insertion and force control are generic commonalities; pinning a card does not test dynamic damping adjustment.
